name: airpods-control
title: AirPods Control
description: Control AirPods listening modes and Conversation Awareness from Raycast with the airpods-control CLI.
author: raulg

commands.name: set-noise-cancellation
commands.title: Set Noise Cancellation
commands.subtitle: Listening Mode
commands.description: Set the AirPods to Noise Cancellation (ANC) listening mode.

commands.name: set-transparency
commands.title: Set Transparency
commands.subtitle: Listening Mode
commands.description: Set the AirPods to Transparency listening mode.

commands.name: set-adaptive
commands.title: Set Adaptive
commands.subtitle: Listening Mode
commands.description: Set the AirPods to Adaptive listening mode when supported by your AirPods.

commands.name: set-off
commands.title: Disable Noise Control
commands.subtitle: Listening Mode
commands.description: Set the AirPods to the Off listening mode (no Noise Cancellation or Transparency).

commands.name: cycle-listening-mode
commands.title: Cycle Listening Mode
commands.subtitle: AirPods
commands.description: Cycle through your preferred listening modes. The current mode is read from the connected AirPods before cycling, and unsupported modes are skipped.

preferences.name: cycleAnc
preferences.title: Modes to Cycle Through
preferences.label: Noise Cancellation
preferences.description: Include Noise Cancellation when cycling listening modes.

preferences.name: cycleTransparency
preferences.label: Transparency
preferences.description: Include Transparency when cycling listening modes.

preferences.name: cycleAdaptive
preferences.label: Adaptive
preferences.description: Include Adaptive when cycling listening modes. Skipped automatically if your AirPods don't support it.

preferences.name: cycleOff
preferences.label: Off
preferences.description: Include Off when cycling listening modes.

commands.name: toggle-conversation-awareness
commands.title: Toggle Conversation Awareness
commands.subtitle: AirPods
commands.description: Toggle Conversation Awareness on or off. Requires AirPods that support Conversation Awareness.

commands.name: refresh-airpods-status
commands.title: Refresh AirPods Status
commands.subtitle: AirPods
commands.description: Refresh the Listening Mode and Conversation Awareness subtitles now and about once a minute while Background Refresh is active. If deactivated, the last confirmed values remain visible until another refresh or control command.

commands.name: update-airpods-control-cli
commands.title: Update Airpods-Control CLI
commands.subtitle: AirPods
commands.description: Install the airpods-control CLI when it is missing or update it through Homebrew.

preferences.name: simulateHomebrewUnavailable
preferences.title: Testing
preferences.label: Simulate Homebrew Unavailable
preferences.description: For local testing only. Hide Homebrew during setup checks while keeping CLI detection active.

preferences.name: cliPath
preferences.title: CLI Path
preferences.description: Full path to the airpods-control binary. Leave empty to auto-detect it in /opt/homebrew/bin and /usr/local/bin.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
